# Sample AI output: coding Skill on the six field notes

**What this is:** an example of what the `qual-coding-networked-publics` Skill produces on `data/fieldnotes.md`. Use it for Try 3b/3c if you don't have AI access or get stuck.

**Provenance:** generated by Claude (Opus 5.5) on 5 Oct 2026, following `skills/qual-coding/SKILL.md`. Your own run will differ in wording, and possibly in some calls. That variation is part of the point.

| excerpt_id | code | evidence (verbatim) | confidence | rationale (one line) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FN-01 | other: nostalgia | "mostly "my grandma used to bring me here" stories" | high | Members use the post to share memories of a place that no longer exists in that form. |
| FN-01 | other: intergenerational memory | "the only place my kids hear about these stalls" | medium | The group is framed as a channel for passing food heritage to the next generation. |
| FN-01 | persistence | "The admin pinned it." | low | Pinning keeps the thread available over time; arguable, as nothing has resurfaced yet. |
| FN-02 | persistence | "links to old messages in the group from 2023" | high | Earlier discussions are recorded and referred back to. |
| FN-02 | persistence | "scroll up lah, we discussed already" | high | Members expect the archive to be consulted before asking again. |
| FN-02 | searchability | "the search bar "doesn't find anything" when she types the stall name in Chinese" | high | Platform search fails for some languages, shaping what is findable and by whom. |
| FN-02 | other: newcomer norms | "scroll up lah, we discussed already" | medium | Inferred: a gentle sanction teaching newcomers the group's expectations. |
| FN-03 | spreadability | "forwarded to at least three other groups" | high | Content moved beyond the original group within an hour. |
| FN-03 | visibility | "asked the original poster to take the uncle's face out of the photo" | medium | Concern that a person is now visible to audiences beyond the one intended. |
| FN-03 | other: consent | "asked the original poster to take the uncle's face out of the photo" | medium | The person pictured did not choose to be shared; raises a consent question within the community. |
| FN-03 | ETHICS-FLAG | (photo of an identifiable stall owner described) | n/a | Field note refers to an image showing a real person's face; do not reproduce the image in outputs. |
| FN-04 | spreadability | "The Instagram account reposted a member's review" | high | Content moved from Telegram to Instagram. |
| FN-04 | visibility | "I wrote it for the group, not for IG." | high | The author intended a bounded audience; reposting collapsed contexts. |
| FN-04 | visibility | "but the IG is public what, anyone can see anyway" | high | A competing view of audience: once public, visibility is assumed. |
| FN-04 | other: attribution | "reposted a member's review without crediting them" | medium | Authorship and credit are at stake, not only audience. |
| FN-05 | searchability | "she never uses the group's search" | low | Refers to non-use of platform search; her actual lookup is offline (notebook, menu boards), so this is arguable. |
| FN-05 | other: lurking / reading practice | "reads the group "like the newspaper", every morning, but rarely posts" | medium | Describes a routine, mostly receptive mode of participation. |
| FN-06 | persistence | "Screenshot from 2019 resurfaced" | high | An old message returns years later. |
| FN-06 | persistence | "Telegram doesn't let them delete other people's old messages" | high | The platform's archive outlasts the author's wishes. |
| FN-06 | spreadability | "Screenshot from 2019" | medium | Screenshotting is a form of copying; inferred that it was re-shared into the thread. |
| FN-06 | other: nostalgia | "members sharing what they miss about stalls that have closed" | medium | Same pattern as FN-01: loss and memory around closed stalls. |

### For the researcher to check

- **Low confidence:** FN-01 persistence (pinning), FN-05 searchability (offline vs platform search).
- **Other labels to review:** nostalgia (FN-01, FN-06): candidate new code? Intergenerational memory, newcomer norms, consent, attribution, lurking / reading practice.
- **ETHICS-FLAG:** FN-03 (identifiable face in a shared photo).
- **Inferred, not stated:** FN-02 newcomer norms; FN-06 spreadability.
